channel.title: PatinaHall Updates
channel.description: Official, dated updates from PatinaHall — a marketplace for vintage furniture, antiques, design objects, and independent stores.

item.title: PatinaHall can now prepare Shopify catalogues
item.description: Vintage furniture and antiques shops using Shopify can now bring their existing catalogue into a private PatinaHall workspace without rebuilding every listing.

item.title: Entourage Finds is now featured on PatinaHall
item.description: A dedicated Entourage Finds Store page now brings its current furniture and object selection together on PatinaHall.

item.title: PatinaHall is live
item.description: The first public version of PatinaHall is now open for discovering vintage furniture, antiques, independent stores, and practical buying guides.
